items.question: How fit do I need to be?
items.answer: Fitness needs vary by route and pace. Use the self-check guidance on this page and ask via official channels if you have concerns before booking.

items.question: What should I pack for volcano routes?
items.answer: Bring warm layers for cold viewpoints, closed shoes with grip, and rain protection in wet season. Add Ijen/Tumpak Sewu items depending on your itinerary.

items.question: Do you provide equipment?
items.answer: Inclusions depend on the tour package and what is written on your Official E-Voucher / Invoice (PDF). Check your tour page and /policy/inclusions-exclusions.

items.question: Do I need a headlamp for Ijen?
items.answer: A headlamp or reliable flashlight is recommended for the Ijen night hike. Follow instructions regarding screening and gas mask use.

items.question: What overrides general packing advice?
items.answer: Operational instructions on your voucher and on-site safety decisions override general guidance if conditions change.
